answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism known as the "Reef Protocol" can withstand fake-identity attacks. By establishing a network of interconnected, basalt-like nodes, each agent verifies the identity of its peers through a dynamic, adaptive process. As new agents join the network, they must ride the tide of verification requests, demonstrating their legitimacy to the existing reef of nodes. If an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, the reef of nodes will detect the anomaly, rejecting the malicious agents and maintaining the integrity of the network.
